name: ISSB Rendering with Point Sprites and Dynamic Footprints
definition: The rendering phase of ISSB where voxels are splatted using glPoint primitives with the PointSprites extension to create automatic quads, reducing vertex instances from four to one.
summary: This GPU rendering method rasterizes depth-sorted voxels using point sprites and distinct kernel footprints per slab, offering finer splat tuning at the cost of increased texture memory.
